task.title: A flag at the closest-approach point is hidden under the ✕ marker
task.body:
## What the player sees
Target a flag or wreck that sits exactly where the closest-approach ✕ falls on the map: the ✕ draws over the `⚑`/`☠`, so the mark you are aiming at disappears.

## Why
The marker pass draws ✕ after surface marks and the later glyph wins the cell (noted in ADR 0066 S3, #872, `internal/tui/screens/orbit.go` glyph pass).

## Want
Decide which wins the cell for a surface target (the targeted mark, most likely, since the ✕ means nothing for a point on the ground). Guard at 140x40 with the site under the ✕; show it red first.
